single_crash.description: One name falls hard against a flat market, days before earnings.
single_crash.first_output:
NVDA is down 8.4% today, which may be related to the report that chip export restrictions widened to include high-bandwidth memory. That's the move commanding attention on your watchlist, with the company set to report earnings in three days. AAPL and KO are both flat and quiet.

The broader market is down modestly -- the S&P off 0.2%, the Nasdaq 0.3% -- with nothing notable moving outside your list. NVDA reports Wednesday.

theme_rally_policy_headline.description: A whole theme rallies together beside a policy headline.
theme_rally_policy_headline.first_output:
The AI power and infrastructure names are the story today -- all five up between 4.9% and 6.1%, running together as a group. VST leads at +6.1%, CEG at +5.8%, with VRT, ETN and GEV right behind. The move coincided with regulatory approval for faster grid connections for large data centers.

The mega-cap tech names you're tracking are barely moving, up three to six tenths of a percent, in line with the broader market's +0.4% to +0.5%.

Next earnings dates for everything on your watchlist are about 30 days out.
